character.name: 荒祠咒师 / abandoned shrine curse adept
character.desc: Elderly Chinese man with wispy white beard, tall folded black cloth cap and dark violet scarf, patched charcoal and faded mustard ritual robe, bone-bead bracelet and hooked wooden ritual staff. Holds yellow talisman strips. Lean crooked staff-bearing silhouette distinct from wandering adept.
character.special: binding curse ritual, plant hooked staff and draw a circular ward with free hand, talisman strips unfurl

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
